notes:
Original Table 4 prints background partial eta squared .204; retain as printed despite apparent numerical inconsistency with sums of squares/F. Narrative p. 692 says background accounted for 20% of shared variance. No replication r or p exists for the supplied background comparison. Uninformative denotes authors’ explicit omission of this question, not an inference from significance. Quotes normalize PDF glyphs/whitespace.
Completion source review (n_o): The critical two-way ANOVA explicitly uses four equal groups of 20, crossing curricular level with heritage/foreign background. No participant exclusions are reported.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Table 4 explicitly labels Partial Eta Squared; Background row prints .204. Preserve partial eta squared rather than relabel as eta squared or recalculate.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Background main-effect row prints Sig. .011 (OCR digits spaced); paired with the same row partial eta squared .204 and F 6.84. Do not substitute the table footnote p < 0.01.
